extras.approval_status: APPROVED by project owner 2026-08-28, per plan.md decision D7 — inherits govity_definition.json's now-approved government_groups facts. lo_limit/n_dims/rotate are technical defaults, already ready to use independent of that sign-off.
extras.vocabulary_and_thresholds: yes/no/abstain/absent/not-voting grouping and lo_limit=0.1/n_dims=3 copied as untuned defaults from every prior city's wpca_definition.json — not independently tuned for Plzeň's 47-member assembly.
extras.rotate_choice: plzen:person:roman-zarzycky (primátor/mayor since 2022-10-18, ANO 2011 a nezávislí, per govity_definition.json's citations) chosen as the PCA rotation anchor purely to fix output-axis sign/orientation for readability — an arbitrary technical choice, not a factual claim.
extras.government_axis_override_note: Unlike Praha, Plzeň does not yet have a detect_government_axis.py-equivalent script wired up — building one (and the underlying wpca-runner scripts under plzen/scripts/analyses/) is out of scope for this draft and needed before wpca can actually be run for Plzeň. This definition file establishes the input config only.
